label: Dania Cyber Security: applicants with an international or IB qualification

rounds.label: International qualification application round
rounds.note: Dania publishes 15 March at noon without a year on its page for the first September 2027 intake. Confirm the deadline when the application cycle opens.

milestones.label: Apply with an international or IB qualification
milestones.note: Dania publishes the day and month without an explicit year on its September 2027 programme page. Current school records, verification form and photo ID accompany the application.

milestones.label: Upload final diploma as soon as received
milestones.note: Follow the instructions Dania sends during admissions. No fixed final-IB-results date or blanket late-results permission is published; agree the arrangements for July IB results with Dania.

milestones.label: Reply to any offer by the date in your offer
milestones.note: Dania has not published a 2027 reply deadline on the programme page. Use the offer instructions.

submissionItems.label: Diploma and transcript, or latest transcript before graduation
submissionItems.note: Dania says translation is not required. If you graduate after the deadline, upload your latest transcript with the application; no separate predicted-grade form is specified.

submissionItems.label: School-signed and stamped upper-secondary verification form
submissionItems.note: Dania requires the form; ask admissions where to obtain the current template and how IB subject evidence should be recorded.

submissionItems.label: Final upper-secondary diploma
submissionItems.note: Upload as soon as received according to Dania’s admission-period instructions. Confirm arrangements for official IB results separately.

submissionItems.label: Sign the application; use a signature page if applying without MitID
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: Dania admissions, using the official portal instructions
submissionItems.note: Follow the national optagelse.dk instructions for the signature page when applying without MitID; an unsigned application is incomplete.

submissionItems.label: English subject evidence and any agreed test result
submissionItems.note: English B is the specific requirement. Dania separately lists English C plus tests: IELTS Academic/Indicator 6.5; TOEFL/iBT Home Edition 4.5 or 94; Cambridge C1 180 or C2 200; Oxford C1 with 85 in each part at Dania or an approved agency. Tests are valid for two years. Confirm whether this route meets the specific English B condition before booking.

supplementarySteps: Dania assesses additional qualifications under quota 2; ask which documents support your qualifications because no complete scoring rubric is published.
Confirm final IB-results delivery and any tuition exemption with admissions before relying on a late final diploma or a fee status.
Apply for housing after acceptance. Dania offers guidance but owns no accommodation; orientation takes place in the week before study start.

notes: The 1 February 2027 opening is explicit on the Danish programme page. The 15 March noon deadline is an undated annual rule on the English September 2027 page and is marked provisional.
No inherited 5 July documentation deadline, 28 July offer date or 2 August reply date is asserted as a Dania-specific deadline.
Choice ranking and signature-page procedure reuse the existing national optagelse guidance. This route replaces the generic route for this Opportunity.
